STEP 1: The Window
Your timing is the number one reason you're losing.
Not your strategy. Not your discipline.

Not your strategy. Not your discipline.

Your timing.
Most of you are at the desk from the open to the close, chasing every move that appears.
And the more time you spend in the market, the more risk you put on.
More risk does not equal more money.
The market is not equally tradeable all day.

Most of the session is noise.

“If I trade less, don't I make less?”

So I'm going to give you 3 ways in.

1. Inverse fair value gap
2. Order block made in liquidity
3. Three candle rotation
They're ranked earliest to latest.

They're ranked earliest to latest.

Which is the same as saying best price to most certain.

Earlier → better entry, less confirmation
Later → more certainty, worse price

There's no perfect one.

There's the right one for the day.
1. The inverse fair value gap

1. The inverse fair value gap

The earliest sign.
A fair value gap is a hole where price moved so fast it skipped a level.
If we're genuinely still going lower, price comes back into that hole and carries on down.
An inverse fair value gap is when it fails to do that.

Price tried to go one way and couldn't.

That failure is your signal.
